changes.from: Autonomous forklift (AGV/AMR), not a mobile robot platform in the usual sense; weight from VisionNav's model comparison page.
changes.to: Scope review (#16, 2026-11-17): kept as an in-scope AGV. VisionNav's own page titles it 'VNR20 Reach Truck AGV/AMR' and lists 2000 kg rated load, 7000 mm standard lift, 2.0 m/s and a 1915 mm minimum turning radius - a self-driving industrial truck, i.e. an AGV, which the owner's exclusion list (arms, cobots, vacuums, lawn/pool, drones, toys, cars/robotaxis, static or companion robots) does not cover. Weight 3460 kg from VisionNav's model comparison page.
